name: example-client
verifyToken: paste the install's VERIFY_TOKEN here if you have it - keeps this check off the public chat quota

twilio.authToken: paste the Twilio auth token here to enable the webhook signature check
twilio.accountSid: paste the Twilio account SID here too, plus the two fields below, to also enable the phone number config check

elevenLabs.apiKey: paste an ElevenLabs API key here to enable the voice agent settings check
elevenLabs.agentId: paste the agent id here too

resend.apiKey: paste a Resend API key here to enable the email domain check
